welcome.title: Welcome to your portfolio editor
welcome.body: Here's a quick, hands-on tour to get you up to speed. You can skip anytime.

dragBlock.title: Drag a block onto your page
dragBlock.body: The panel lists every available block. Drag any block from here onto the canvas to add it to your page.

blockProps.title: Block properties live here
blockProps.body: Dropping a block selects it automatically — its settings appear in this panel.

contentTab.title: Content: the block's text and media
contentTab.body: The Content tab is where you edit the block's actual text, images, and links.

designTab.title: Design: colors, borders, and corners
designTab.body: The Design tab controls typography, background color, borders, shadows, and animations.

layoutTab.title: Layout: size, spacing, and position
layoutTab.body: The Layout tab controls gap, min-height, alignment, and grid placement.

switchPages.title: Switch between pages
switchPages.body: Switch between the different parts of your portfolio website.

openNav.title: Open Navigation
openNav.body: Click Navigation to set up your site's header — brand, logo, menu links, and styling.

navSetup.title: Navigation · Setup
navSetup.body: The Setup tab is where you set your brand text, navbar size, logo, and menu links.

logo.title: Your logo lives here
logo.body: This is your logo uploader — a PNG, JPEG, or WEBP added here shows in the header on your live page.

navDesign.title: Navigation · Design
navDesign.body: The Design tab controls header colors, borders, and typography for your nav links.

contactForm.title: Your inquiry form
contactForm.body: Click Contact Form to set up the form visitors use to reach you.

contactSetup.title: Contact · Setup
contactSetup.body: The Setup tab sets the form's language, title, and description. The form's fields and layout are fixed.

contactDesign.title: Contact · Design
contactDesign.body: The Design tab restyles the form — text and background colors to match your brand. You can't hide fields, only change how they look.

photos.title: Upload and organize photos
photos.body: Open Photos to create collections and upload images. Gallery blocks pull from a collection.

translate.title: Translate your public pages
translate.body: Switch the language of your navigation, contact form, and collection popups all at once. Right-to-left languages flip the layout automatically.

theme.title: Pick your colors and fonts
theme.body: Theme controls your five brand colors and typography. Every block's style options use this palette.

preview.title: Preview your site at any screen size
preview.body: Switch to preview mode and use the device toggle to check your layout on mobile, tablet, and desktop.

publish.title: Publish to go live
publish.body: When you're happy with your changes, click Publish to push them to your public page.

draftsStep.title: Save drafts and switch versions
draftsStep.body: Save changes at any time. Use Drafts to manage multiple versions. Reopen this tour via the Guide button.
